Problem Statement:
Fix the HTML export template

This PR fixes the HTML export template, addressing the issue raised in #3021

In doing so there's also an update to the pre-commit configuration (without it I wasn't able to commit the change -- the update is stolen from the same config file in Textual).

The issue describes a fix for the HTML export template and an update to the pre-commit configuration. Based on the investigation, the HTML export template is defined in `rich/_export_format.py` as `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT`. The current `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT` is: ```python CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT = """ 
{code}
""" ``` The issue statement mentions fixing the HTML export template. A common issue with this specific template is the placement of the `` tag and potentially the structure of the body/head. FILES: - `rich/_export_format.py`: Modify `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT` to fix the HTML structure. - `.pre-commit-config.yaml`: Update the configuration. ROOT CAUSE: The HTML export template in `rich/_export_format.py` has invalid HTML structure (the `` tag starts after the `` tag). CHANGE: 1. In `rich/_export_format.py`, wrap the entire document within `` tags. 2. Update `.pre-commit-config.yaml` with the configuration from Textual. TEST: Run `pytest tests/test_console.py::test_export_html`.
